overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Gus Gaiffus and Ross Kiah of Medford Square's Palm Press Studio. The guests discussed the history of their photographic atelier, their framing and darkroom services, and their local photo bookstore.

items.title: Guest Backgrounds and Studio History
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced Gus Gaiffus and Ross Kiah, who shared their personal backgrounds in photography and the history of Palm Press Studio since its founding in 1976.

items.title: Relocation to Medford
items.summary: Gus Gaiffus described how the studio relocated from Chelsea to Medford Square and renovated a former bank space into a functional darkroom.

items.title: Studio Services and Darkroom Classes
items.summary: The guests detailed their custom framing, digital printing, wet darkroom rentals, and one-on-one instructional photography lessons.

items.title: Photo Bookstore and Community Events
items.summary: Ross Kiah and Gus Gaiffus discussed their curated photo bookstore and the success of hosting weekday evening book signings and artist talks.

items.title: Partnership and Future Plans
items.summary: Ross Kiah explained how he first met Gus Gaiffus and shared his plans to eventually take over the business and print Gus's archive of photography.
